title: Angels & Demons
classifier_reason: The plot revolves around a symbologist investigating the kidnapping of cardinals and the return of a secret organization.
judge_reason: While the story contains investigative/mystery elements, its pacing, high-stakes pursuit, and suspenseful race to stop a catastrophe align more closely with Thriller than a pure Mystery.

title: Clueless
classifier_reason: The overview focuses on a high school student's social machinations, makeovers, and romantic entanglements with humorous undertones.
judge_reason: The plot description emphasizes social satire, lighthearted matchmaking, and comedic character arcs typical of a teen comedy (with romantic elements). Comedy is the appropriate primary genre.

title: 27 Dresses
classifier_reason: The story centers on Jane's unrequited love and a romantic rivalry involving her sister's engagement.
judge_reason: The central conflict revolves around romantic love and a love triangle (Jane loves the man her sister is marrying), which is a classic Romance premise. Emotional and relationship stakes drive the plot.

title: Attack on Titan: THE LAST ATTACK
classifier_reason: The overview describes a large-scale conflict with a desperate fight to stop a terrifying plan to eradicate the world.
judge_reason: The overview centers on large-scale battles, physical conflict and high-stakes confrontations (the Rumbling and attempts to stop it), which makes Action an appropriate primary genre. While the film is animated and has fantasy elements, Action accurately captures its core tone and events.

title: Those Who Wish Me Dead
classifier_reason: The story involves assassins, pursuit, and a race against time with a natural disaster, creating suspense and high stakes.
judge_reason: The plot centers on pursuit, imminent danger, and suspense (assassins, survival, and a spreading forest fire), which align well with Thriller conventions. While it contains action elements, Thriller is an appropriate primary genre.

title: Kong Tao
classifier_reason: The overview describes a property developer using illegal and harmful means (black magic) to seize land, leading to unexplained deaths.
judge_reason: The synopsis centers on black magic (Hexing) and unexplained, possibly supernatural deaths; the occult/supernatural element and fear-driven plot align more closely with Horror than a straightforward Crime story. While criminal motives are present, the supernatural focus makes Horror the better primary genre.

title: The Bourne Supremacy
classifier_reason: This movie is about a former assassin who is forced to fight for his life against those from his past in a thrilling chase.
judge_reason: The synopsis focuses on espionage, pursuit, combat and a trained assassin forced back into violent action—hallmarks of the Action genre (with strong thriller elements), so Action is an appropriate label.

title: Monster House
classifier_reason: The overview describes a frightening house, secrets, and teens going up against it, indicating a horror theme.
judge_reason: Premise centers on supernatural/monstrous threats, a frightening haunted house, and teens confronting it — all hallmarks of the horror genre.

title: The Eight Hundred
classifier_reason: The overview describes a battle and soldiers fighting under siege against an invading army, clearly indicating a war setting.
judge_reason: The synopsis describes a historical military siege and combat between Chinese and Japanese forces in 1937, which clearly fits the War genre.

title: Madulas
classifier_reason: The overview suggests a shift from romance to obsession and a dark secret, indicating a suspenseful and potentially dangerous plot.
judge_reason: The plot elements—obsession, a hidden dangerous secret, escalating tension around a charismatic newcomer—fit the conventions of a thriller (suspense, danger, psychological stakes).
